title: breonia sphaerantha
intro: Breonia sphaerantha, commonly known as African breonia, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family, native to tropical Africa. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, malaria, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Breonia sphaerantha are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties. The bioactive constituents of Breonia sphaerantha include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
